{{Enemy Echo Tabs}} {{Enemy Infobox |name = Lorelei |title = Queen of the Night |image = Lorelei Icon.png |dmgtype = Havoc |echo = Yes |class = Overlord |family = Remnant Creature |group = |nation = Rinascita |region = Nimbus Sanctum |subregion = Atrium of Reflections |drops = Cleansing Conch |variants = Tactical Hologram: Lorelei }}{{Description|Once a remnant creature in Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.}} {{Lang|'''Lorelei'''|zh=罗蕾莱}} is an [[Overlord Class]] [[Boss]] in ''[[Wuthering Waves]]'' that can be found in the {{Location|Nimbus Sanctum|nocat=1}}. ==Drops== {{Boss Rewards|regular=1|exclusive=Cleansing Conch}} ==Stats== {{Enemy Stats}} ==Abilities== ==Trophies== {{Trophies|Lorelei|customheader=Lorelei}} ==Tutorial== {{Tutorial|Lorelei}} ==Description== {{Description|This enemy has {{Color|help|higher RES}} to {{Color|Havoc damage}}.
Once a remnant creature in Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.
Yet wicked desires have transformed her into the "Queen of the Night," seeking to cloak the Sanctum in endless darkness to clear all sins.
With her final grasp on reason, Lorelei sealed herself within the atrium, where she sings a haunting lament, awaiting one who can awaken her from this dismal slumber.|Description When Discovered}} ==Soundtracks== {{Soundtracks by Category Table|type=combat}} ==Trivia== ===Etymology=== *"Lorelei" is the name of a siren that lures fishermen to their deaths in German mythology, inspired by an infamous real life maritime disaster site of the same name. *The "Queen of the Night" is a character from Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's 1791 opera ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Magic_Flute The Magic Flute]''. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Lorelei |zhs = 罗蕾莱 |zht = 羅蕾萊 |ja = ローレライ |ko = 로렐라이 |es = Lorelei |fr = Lorelei |de = Lorelei }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.0}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
